project.name: SpaceScale
project.summary: A shared visual classroom where WebMCP agents work with handwriting, video, and live ideas under the exact permissions of the people who invite them.
project.ai_usage: The visiting WebMCP agent connects and challenges selected class ideas, interprets selected handwriting, follows bounded saved problem steps, and creates source-linked shared learning structures without a separate SpaceScale model backend.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported product scoping, WebMCP tool and permission architecture, implementation, automated tests, debugging, review, demo preparation, and submission documentation.
